name: wp-project-boilerplate
title: WordPress Project Boilerplate
description: A base boilerplate for Luehrsen // Heinrich WordPress projects.

scripts.release: npm run release:build && npm run release:package && npm run release:verify
scripts.setup: npm ci && composer install --prefer-dist --no-interaction && composer install --working-dir=theme --prefer-dist --no-interaction && composer install --working-dir=plugin --prefer-dist --no-interaction && npm run build
scripts.start: npx wp-env start && npx wp-env run cli wp theme activate theme && npx wp-env run cli sh ./lifecycleScripts/ensure-rewrites.sh
scripts.env:reset: npm run env:clean && npm run env:init
scripts.lint:tools: node --check bin/archiveProject.js && node --check bin/verifyArchives.js && node --check bin/verifyBuiltAssets.js && node --check webpack.config.js && node --check playwright.config.js
scripts.lint: npm run lint:php && npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css && npm run lint:tools
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test:e2e && npm run release
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:php:fix && npm run lint:js:fix && npm run lint:css:fix
scripts.dev: npm run start && npm run watch
scripts.test:unit:env: npm run test:unit:env:plugin && npm run test:unit:env:theme

author: Luehrsen // Heinrich
